function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food from selected restaurants with specified items and their quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurants.description: The name of the restaurant from which the user wants to order food. Use the exact name as registered on Uber Eats.

items.description: A list of item names that the user wants to order from the restaurant.

quantities.description: A list of integers, each representing the quantity of the corresponding item in the order. The quantities should align with the items list by index.
